description: Fixture cases for WI-2 PCF Closure: high-frequency tool schema usability verification. Cases A-J cover schema description accuracy, error message shape, enum visibility, identifier semantics, and role payload visibility across 6 task-main tools.

case_a_work_classify_valid_facts.description: Case A: work_classify with valid facts (all 31 fields) returns classification_status=classified on first attempt.

input.title: Test work item
input.summary: A test work item for classification

case_b_unknown_classification_fact_accep.description: Case B: work_classify with unknown fact key returns CLASSIFICATION_FACT_UNKNOWN with accepted_fields list in error response.

case_c_task_spec_create_task_kind_reject.description: Case C: task_spec_create with task_kind (not spec_kind) is rejected with error message stating task_kind is deprecated and spec_kind should be used.

case_d_review_spec_missing_subject_spec_.description: Case D: review SPEC context_refs validation - schema description must state that review requires subject_spec ref and subject_task_id.

case_e_artifact_ref_string_rejected.description: Case E: context_refs with string items are rejected - schema description must state that artifact refs must be objects with ref_type and artifact_id.
check_schema_description_contains: artifact ref must be an object

case_f_followup_invalid_enum_accepted_va.description: Case F: followup_task_create schema description must list FORBIDDEN_OPERATIONS accepted enum values and follow-up semantics.

case_g_approve_missing_hash_error.description: Case G: approve without expected_spec_hash on canonical SPEC must return error about expected_spec_hash_required, current hash, and corrective action.

case_h_freeze_legacy_spec_error.description: Case H: freeze on legacy SPEC must return error with detected_format=legacy and required_action=create_or_migrate_canonical_spec.
check_error_message_contains: legacy SPEC has no canonical freeze contract

case_i_update_unknown_field_accepted_fie.description: Case I: update with unknown/cross-role field must return error listing accepted mutable fields.

case_j_valid_examples_schema_acceptance.description: Case J: all 6 tools have at least one minimal valid example in their SCHEMA description that can be parsed.
